energyMix.heading: Poland's energy mix — why BESS is the only path to 2040

rows.name: Gas
rows.description: Exposed to geopolitical and import risk, with CO₂ costs making it significantly less profitable by the mid-2030s.

rows.name: Nuclear
rows.description: Nuclear arrives after 2035, so it doesn't contribute to the supply gap that must be solved this decade.

rows.name: Coal
rows.description: EU ETS carbon prices make coal increasingly uneconomical, with a phase-out intended by 2040.

rows.name: Renewables
rows.description: Domestic, deployable now, cost-competitive — but intermittent at scale without storage.

rows.name: BESS
rows.description: Supports renewable buildout, ensuring stable capacity regardless of short-term production spikes.
